edits.old: The activity name `generateContractDocument` is this story's design and is fixed by no source document (GAP-1878; ASM-3080); the design's `TreatmentWorkflow` and `RecordAndApply` are its own.
edits.new:
The activity name `generateContractDocument` is this story's design and is fixed by no source document (GAP-1878; ASM-3080); the design's `TreatmentWorkflow` and `RecordAndApply` are its own.

The local decision record is written in the same `rwb_treatment` transaction as the row change, with an atomic, idempotent append to the rwb-decision ledger. A failed record write stops the generation (MSG-P7-003; GAP-1289). The `treatment` row holds two nullable columns, the document reference and the pinned template version, with their index; the operation and its shapes are taken from RWB-P5-E2026-CON, and the generation event name and decision code are this story's design until the event catalogue owner confirms them (GAP-1878).

The document set of a treatment is composed per treatment type from the catalogue value in force. The rendering is the `generateContractDocument` activity against RWB-P5-E2026-CON. The party set is read as keys and a count from the service's own `v_ace_customer` view. The case status arrives on the signal the parent `CaseWorkflow` forwards. The set outcome travels in the answer and the local decision record (GAP-2684; ASM-B2-S2-013-1 to ASM-B2-S2-013-3).
